title: kate-ui: choose the tab that stays after a close
summary: active_after_close returns the active index after one tab is removed. Closing the last remaining tab returns None. Closing a tab before the active index slides the index down by one. The test goes in the existing layout tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn active_after_close(count: u32, active: u32, closed: u32) -> Option<u32>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: layout.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. The shim module stays after that brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add active_after_close. Keep it pub(crate). Add #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]. count is the tab count before the close. closed is the index that goes away. When count is less than 2, or closed is past the last tab, return None. When active is greater than closed, subtract 1. When active is past the new last index, use that last index. Otherwise keep active. Use one if with || for the None case. Do not nest an if inside an if.  Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch visual_step. The existing test visual_step_moves_one_wrap_row stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test active_after_close_slides_the_index checks count 1 returns None. count 3, active 2, closed 2 returns Some(1). count 3, active 2, closed 0 returns Some(1). count 3, active 0, closed 2 returns Some(0). Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: layout::tests::active_after_close_slides_the_index
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because active_after_close does not exist. After the change three tabs with the last one active become index 1 when that tab closes. One tab closes to None.
